description: CEF 154.0.32 (Chromium 154.0.8037.58) for Windows x64, built with Chromium's proprietary codecs: H.264, AAC and HEVC, which CEF's standard build leaves out. The engine's bytes for Shenora.Chromium, the Chromium shell of the Shenora hybrid app framework for .NET + React: reference it beside Shenora.Chromium in a win-x64 app and the app's layout comes from it, with no download at build time. H.264, AAC and HEVC are covered by patents licensed through patent pools, and this package comes with no patent licence of any kind: whether an app that ships it needs one is the app's to decide. HEVC plays through the machine's own decoder (a GPU, or Windows' HEVC extension).
